rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT cluster calculation using an open-source code; requires basic familiarity with computational chemistry but no novel algorithm implementation.
rationale.execution: Three-step pipeline: constructing cluster models, running SCF DFT calculations, and extracting HOMO-LUMO gaps. Setup of DFT software and file I/O add moderate orchestration complexity.

difficulty.reasoning: The task reproduces a simple first-principles electronic structure calculation on small clusters. The method is standard DFT, the pipeline is moderate but not highly complex, and resource demands are trivial.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small cluster DFT calculations (few tens of atoms) are light, run on CPU, and require trivial memory; no external dataset needed.
